_comment: The product groups the homepage designs showcase, in display order. Keep to the lines NovoTech sells most in Canada and the US; the full list stays on products.html. `verb` is the action the machine performs (used by the kinetic headlines), `fact` a one-line range, `tone` the flat field colour a tile takes (dark / mid / light / orange).

groups.name: Press brakes
groups.line: CNC hydraulic, hybrid and servo-electric press brakes from 22 to 1,323 US tons, 4 to 20 ft.

groups.name: Fiber lasers
groups.line: Sheet and plate fiber lasers from 4 × 4 ft to 10 × 164 ft, 1.5 to 80 kW, with automation.

groups.name: Band saws
groups.line: Manual, semi-automatic, automatic and double-column band saws from Ø9″ to 87″, premium and value lines.

groups.name: Shears
groups.line: Hydraulic swing-beam and variable-rake shears, mechanical guillotines and sheet metal shears, 16 ga to 1-9/16″.

groups.name: Angle rolls
groups.line: Hydraulic angle rolls and tube rollers from a 2 HP bench bender to HEB 600 beam benders — rings, arcs and spirals.
groups.fact: angle, pipe, tube, flat bar · to HEB 600

groups.name: Plate rollers
groups.line: Hydraulic 4-roll and 3-roll plate rolls to 20 ft and 3-3/8″ plate, NC and CNC, plus motorized 3-roll rolls from 3.4 ft.

groups.name: Ironworkers
groups.line: Hydraulic ironworkers from 44 to 276 US tons: punch, shear flat bar and angle, notch — single- and double-piston.

groups.name: Rebar benders & cutters
groups.line: Stationary and portable rebar benders, hydraulic rebar cutters, stirrup and spiral benders and automatic lines.

groups.name: Pipe & tube benders
groups.line: CNC, NC, all-electric and hydraulic mandrel and rotary-draw benders from Ø15/32″ tube to Ø8-5/8″ pipe.

groups.name: Tube lasers
groups.line: Two- and three-chuck tube and profile lasers to Ø25.2″ and 40 ft bars, 1.5 to 40 kW.

groups.name: Sheet metal brakes & folders
groups.line: Box and pan, magnetic, hand and hydraulic brakes, CNC folders, roofing brakes and 3-in-1 machines.

groups.name: Deburring & finishing
groups.line: Wide-belt deburring, edge rounding, deslagging and brush machines for cut parts, 5-7/8″ to 53-1/8″ wide, dry or wet.

groups.name: Press brake tooling
groups.line: EUROSTAMP punches, dies, holders and adapters made in Italy for Amada-Promecam, Trumpf, Wila, Bystronic, LVD and American styles.
groups.fact: made in Italy · every clamping style

groups.name: Pipe polishers & sanders
groups.line: Automatic, orbital and centreless pipe sanders and polishers for round and square tube, Ø3/16″ to Ø15-3/4″.

groups.name: Corner grinders
groups.line: Gecam corner grinders for the weld seams of boxes, cabinets, doors and tube frames — flush or radiused, ready for paint.
groups.fact: weld seams of boxes, doors, frames

groups.name: Drill presses
groups.line: Gear-head, inverter and column drill presses, 15/16″ to 2″ in steel, with power feed and tapping.

groups.name: Hydraulic presses
groups.line: Hydraulic shop and bench presses from 10 tons, H-frame and four-column presses to 661 US tons, C-frame and straightening presses.

groups.name: Welding positioners & rolls
groups.line: Welding positioners from 22 to 44,092 lb, turning rolls to 220,462 lb, column and boom manipulators and welding tables.

groups.name: Laser welders
groups.line: Handheld laser welders from 0.8 kW, robotic laser welding cells to 20 kW, and laser cladding.

groups.name: Horizontal press brakes
groups.line: NC hydraulic horizontal presses for bending, straightening and punching, 11 to 165 US tons.
